Message:
perf: Update locking order

Update the locking order to note that ctx::lock nests inside of
child_mutex, as per:

  perf_ioctl():                ctx::mutex
  -> perf_event_for_each():    event::child_mutex
    -> _perf_event_enable():   ctx::lock
